subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: When workspace package.json or HOOK.md exceeds the supported size limit, should discovery warn and skip it, fail the hook check clearly, or silently omit it?
rationale: The limit is sensible hardening, but each behavior has a different compatibility and operator-diagnosability contract that cannot be chosen safely from implementation details alone.

options.title: Warn and skip
options.body: Keep discovery available while emitting a bounded, actionable warning naming the rejected metadata file and limit.

options.title: Fail hook discovery clearly
options.body: Return an explicit validation failure so oversized metadata cannot be overlooked, at the cost of making the discovery path stricter for existing setups.

options.title: Silently skip
options.body: Retain the PR’s current behavior, accepting that an existing hook may disappear without an operator-visible reason.

recommendation.title: Warn and skip
recommendation.body: Keep discovery available while emitting a bounded, actionable warning naming the rejected metadata file and limit.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the adjacent merged bounded-read implementation and are best positioned to align this branch once a maintainer confirms the product behavior.
